validation.summary: 15 defect(s) detected. Structural score: 0.867. Coverage score: 0.962. Hallucination score: 1.000. Semantic score: 1.000. Overall score: 0.847.

review.overall_assessment: The diagram covers the main CTS processing flow and most listed use-case steps, but several modeled branches terminate without any continuation, and the terminal-user operation requirements are still not represented. No additional evidence-backed semantic conflicts were found beyond these coverage and control-flow gaps.

defects.description: Action N14 is a dead end with no outgoing control flow after the buy-transaction suspended-operation branch.
defects.evidence: R26 requires the buy transaction to suspend all operations when operations are suspended. The diagram routes the guard 'operations suspended' from N11 to N14, but N14 has no successor edge.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N14 to the appropriate termination or merge point so the suspended-operation path has a defined continuation.

defects.description: Requirement R10 is not represented by any distinct diagram element.
defects.evidence: R10 states that the CTS shall provide easy operations to terminal users. No node or edge explicitly models this terminal-user operation capability.
defects.suggested_action: Add a diagram element or dedicated activity that represents CTS providing easy terminal-user operations.

defects.description: Requirement R11 is not represented by any distinct diagram element.
defects.evidence: R11 states that terminal-user operations shall be confined to mouse clicks and keyboard inputs. No node or edge models this constraint.
defects.suggested_action: Add a diagram element or constraint that explicitly captures mouse-click and keyboard-input operation limits.

strengths: Core CTS instruction flow is modeled end-to-end from receive, analyze, divide, and match.
Buy, sell, cancel, save-trade-information, and query use-case paths are all present.
The system-manager access and maintainer support requirements are represented in the diagram.
Negative branches are explicitly modeled for several exception conditions, improving traceability.
